a.lede: Originally launching only with Touch ID, Apple’s folding phone now borrows a feature from the new HomeView and can recognize your mug, but it’s likely not as secure as Face ID.
a.title: The iPhone Duo Is Getting a Limited Version of Face ID

b.lede: The new Google Wallet app brings Gemini agentic shopping to US-based iOS users – sorry, no tap-to-pay.
b.title: Google Wallet comes to your iPhone – but without this feature
